title: ACE local configuration (.ace.json)
description: Local deployment information only: who this user is, and which servers this machine talks to. Channels, subscriptions and presence live on a server.

$schema.description: Editor autocomplete hint; ignored by the runtime.

username.description: The real user's name or nick. It is the second level of the naming hierarchy (<ns>:<username>:<name>): prepended to names, never stored as a field. May be omitted when a host-global file (or $USER) provides it. No colons.

propertyNames.description: Server name: a local handle (never uploaded). No colons.

servers.description: Servers this machine talks to. Each one is a complete ACE domain: Redis, a member directory, and the channels on it.

defaultActivation.description: Fallback activation when neither the subscription nor the message decides (RFC §8).

max.description: How many manual events to retain (default 100).

ttlMs.description: How long a retained manual event lives (default 24h).

projectConfig.description: Host-global files only: "ignore" makes this file win over a project .ace.json, so a cloned repository cannot redirect the session.

url.description: Redis connection string, e.g. redis://user:${PASS}@host:6379 or rediss://… . ${VAR} is interpolated from the environment. Credentials stay in this file and are never broadcast.

namespace.description: Namespace this server owns; keys live under it (<ns>:agents, <ns>:entry, <ns>:ch:<name>). Defaults to "ace". No colons.

description.description: Free-form note about this server, for humans.

subscribe.description: Channel names this session reads on this server: a subscription belongs to the server that carries it. A short name (ci-failures) is uploaded as <ns>:<username>:<name> under this server's namespace; a full channel name passes through. Omit for direct messages only.
